details:
Hello,

I would like to report an issue regarding the handling of group bans in VRChat, which is currently causing confusion and frustration among users.

This issue revolves around the lack of clear and informative error messages when attempting to access group and instances after being banned.

1. Notification of Group Bans:

In the past, when a user was banned from a group, they would receive a notification informing them of the ban. However, it appears that this notification feature is no longer functioning as expected. Users are now being banned without any prior warning, leading to a lack of awareness regarding their status within a group.

2. Ambiguity in Joining Banned Groups:

Furthermore, even after being banned, users are still presented with the option to request to join or join a group. The interface remains identical to when a user is not banned from a group, creating a misleading experience. It is crucial to address this by clearly indicating the ban status, preventing banned users from requesting access, and providing explicit information about their ban.

3. Insufficient Error Messaging:

When attempting to join a group instance, even a PUBLIC one (which I believe needs separate attention - I would like to encourage users to support my other proposal regarding voting "against" public group instances: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/remove-or-restrict-public-group-instances), users receive a generic error message that states, "You're not allowed to access this instance". This message lacks essential information, leaving users in the dark about the reason behind the access denial. It is essential to improve error messaging to provide users with clear explanations for such issues.

I strongly urge VRChat to address these concerns promptly to enhance user experience and clarity within the platform. These improvements would not only reduce user frustration but also contribute to a more user-friendly and transparent VRChat environment.

Thank you for considering this report.
title: Enhanced Error Handling and User Notifications for Group Bans
